description: arXiv:2605.14605v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Model providers increasingly release the weights of large language models. Although these models are safety-aligned before release, their safeguards can often be removed by fine-tuning on harmful data. A growing class of defenses aims to make alignment robust to such malicious fine-tuning, but these defenses are typically evaluated again...
